product.name: Bread Wallet by Miden
product.valueLine: Self-custody and private-by-design payments for the Miden network.

blocks.text: Bread Wallet by Miden is the official self-custodial wallet for the Miden network.

blocks.heading: Self-custody by default
blocks.text: Your wallet keys are generated on your device and kept there in encrypted storage. No account or sign-up is required.

blocks.heading: Choose how you pay
blocks.text: Send and receive Miden assets, with public or private transfer behavior available where the selected flow supports it.

blocks.heading: Recovery that keeps you in control
blocks.text: Your recovery phrase restores key ownership. Guardian accounts can add recovery and private-state continuity through your selected operator, while neither your device nor the Guardian can spend alone.

blocks.heading: Open source
blocks.text: Bread Wallet is open source. Review the code and follow development on GitHub.

fields.name: Bread Wallet by Miden
fields.subtitle: Private self-custody
fields.promotionalText: Self-custody and private-by-design payments for the Miden network, with recovery options and a built-in dApp browser.

blocks.heading: Made for iPhone
bullets: Unlock with Face ID or your device passcode.
Share an address by QR code and choose recall timing for supported transfers.
Browse Miden dApps inside the wallet and review requests before confirming them.
Choose a Guardian operator when creating a Guardian account.

fields.name: Bread Wallet by Miden
fields.shortDescription: Self-custody and private-by-design payments for the Miden network.

blocks.heading: Made for Android
bullets: Unlock with biometric authentication or your device passcode.
Share an address by QR code and choose recall timing for supported transfers.
Browse Miden dApps and review supported actions before confirming them.
Create proofs locally or use a configured proving service.
Swap supported Miden assets from the wallet.

fields.name: Bread Wallet by Miden
fields.shortDescription: Self-custody and private-by-design payments for Miden, built for your browser.

blocks.heading: Made for Chrome
bullets: Connect to Miden sites and review each request in a wallet-owned confirmation window.
Keep the wallet close in Chrome's side panel.
Protect wallet access with your password.
Create proofs locally or use a configured proving service.
Send Miden assets and confirm supported dApp flows.
